title: Read fixed-width ASCII file using SPSS or SAS Setup file — read_ascii_setup
text: data Name ASCII (.txt .dat) file contains data. file may zipped file extension .zip. setup_file Name SPSS SAS setup file - .sps .sas (.txt also accepted files zipped format). See parse_setup type determined. use_value_labels TRUE, fixes value labels data. e.g. column "sex" values 0 1, setup file says 0 = male 1 = female, make change. use_clean_names TRUE fixes column names default column name setup file (e.g. V1, V2) descriptive label column provided file (e.g. age, sex, etc.). select_columns Specify columns dataset want. NULL, return columns. Accepts column number (e.g. 1:5), column name (e.g. V1, V2, etc.) column label (e.g. VICTIM_NAME, CITY, etc.). coerce_numeric TRUE (default) make columns values can made numeric numeric columns. Every value checked, column text value stays character. Columns setup file says text (SPSS "()", SAS "$") always stay character, leading zeros kept. Useful FALSE variables leading zeros - US Census FIPS codes given numbers. Columns setup file gives implied decimal places (e.g. V7 37-43 (1) SPSS V7 37-43 .1 SAS) get decimal point whatever coerce_numeric : value "0000785" 1 implied decimal place becomes 78.5, text "000078.5" coerce_numeric FALSE. Values already decimal point kept . missing_values setup file's missing values set NA. Setup files often missing values section commented (e.g. "* MISSING VALUES" SPSS inside /* */ SAS) codes stay data unless user chooses otherwise. "" (default) Use every missing value setup file,     ignoring whether commented . earlier versions     . "active" Use missing values commented     , SPSS SAS . "none" use missing values; every code kept. Missing values matched value, SPSS SAS, missing value written 9 also matches 09 0000009 data, except columns setup file says text (SPSS "()", SAS "$"), must text. Value labels applied first, missing value also value label (e.g. 9 = "Unknown") keeps label rather becoming NA unless use_value_labels = FALSE.

text: sas_ascii_reader() spss_ascii_reader() used need read fixed-width ASCII (text) file comes setup file. file combinations sometimes referred .txt+.sps, .txt+.sas, .dat+.sps, .dat+.sas. setup file provides instructions create name columns, fix key-value pairs (sometimes called value labels). common government data, particularly data produced 2010.

title: Read fixed-width ASCII file using SAS Setup file — sas_ascii_reader
code: sas_ascii_reader(   dataset_name,   sas_name,   value_label_fix = TRUE,   real_names = TRUE,   keep_columns = NULL,   coerce_numeric = TRUE,   missing_values = c("all", "active", "none") )

title: Read fixed-width ASCII file using SAS Setup file — sas_ascii_reader
text: dataset_name Name ASCII (.txt) file contains data. file may zipped file extension .zip. sas_name Name SAS Setup file - .sas .txt file. value_label_fix TRUE, fixes value labels data. e.g. column "sex" values 0 1, setup file says 0 = male 1 = female, make change. real_names TRUE fixes column names default column name SPSS setup file (e.g. V1, V2) name says column called (e.g. age, sex, etc.). keep_columns Specify columns dataset want. NULL, return columns. Accepts column number (e.g. 1:5), column name (e.g. V1, V2, etc.) column label (e.g. VICTIM_NAME, CITY, etc.). coerce_numeric TRUE (default) make columns values can made numeric numeric columns. Every value checked, column text value stays character. Useful FALSE variables leading zeros - US Census FIPS codes. See read_ascii_setup implied decimal places handled. missing_values setup file's missing values set NA. Setup files often missing values section commented (e.g. "* MISSING VALUES" SPSS inside /* */ SAS) codes stay data unless user chooses otherwise. "" (default) Use every missing value setup file,     ignoring whether commented . earlier versions     . "active" Use missing values commented     , SPSS SAS . "none" use missing values; every code kept. Missing values matched value, SPSS SAS, missing value written 9 also matches 09 0000009 data, except columns setup file says text (SPSS "()", SAS "$"), must text. Value labels applied first, missing value also value label (e.g. 9 = "Unknown") keeps label rather becoming NA unless use_value_labels = FALSE.

title: asciiSetupReader 3.0.0
text: Read upgrading: numbers, names, labels missing values now different (correct). Implied decimal places applied. Columns setup file gives implied decimal places (V7 37-43 (1) SPSS, V7 37-43 .1 SAS) used read whole numbers, value 0000785 785 rather 78.5. now get decimal point, message listing column number decimal places. coerce_numeric = FALSE point added text (“000078.5”). Values already decimal point kept , SPSS SAS. Value labels missing values columns, setup files write numbers (1.0, -9.00), now matched value. parse_setup()$setup new decimals column. Column names always unique. two columns get clean name, later ones get short name added, e.g. second “CLOTHING” column, V93, now CLOTHING_V93, PSID’s repeated “RELEASE NUMBER” becomes RELEASE_NUMBER_TA050001 2005 wave. Names compared ignoring case, SPSS SAS , Age AGE count name. , data duplicate names, data$CLOTHING gave first dplyr data.table stopped error. message lists renamed columns. = inside label longer cuts name short. “SEP FATHER < = 5” named X5; now SEP_FROM_FATHER_under_OR_5. % label becomes _percent_ name, < already became _under_ (e.g. “1919 RT % VOTES CAST” X1919_RT_percent_VOTES_CAST, X1919_RT_VOTES_CAST, “1919 RT VOTES CAST” also ). Missing values matched value, SPSS SAS : missing value written 9, 09 0000009 matches data. , written exactly data, V156=0000009 V156=.; never matched 9s 1-column field. Columns setup file says text (SPSS (), SAS $) still need exactly text. Value labels number columns matched value , label 0 now labels data written 0000000 (e.g. 7,997 “updated” values 1960 UCR file used stay 0000000). column now labelled values text rather numbers: 1960 UCR file, columns JAN_LAST_UPDATE “updated” 0. use_value_labels = FALSE keeps codes. Blanks letters NA text columns get value labels: e.g. 166,650 blanks 1960 UCR file now “return received” 15,555 2000 NIBRS batch header “Inactive”, used NA. (SPSS treats blank text value value; SAS treats missing still gives format’s label blank.) blank NA text value without label still NA. number columns blank, NA lone . missing (lone . used kept). Columns setup file says text stay text (SPSS () format, SAS $), SPSS SAS, even every value number, codes ZIP code 01001 keep leading zeros. , column became numeric coerce_numeric = TRUE. SHR example data, rarely filled-ages victims 5 11 now text like victims 1 4, empty text columns character NA rather numeric NA. Use .numeric() column want numbers. Columns without label VARIABLE LABELS LABEL kept, named short name; used dropped. SAS label continued next line read full, names used cut short line’s end longer: e.g. prisoners file’s LFM LFF ..._LOCAL_AUTHORITY ..._LOCAL_AUTHORITY_LFF (one name, made unique) now ..._LOCAL_AUTHORITY_MALE ..._LOCAL_AUTHORITY_FEMALE. 24 names 6 157 setup files used check release changed way. later VALUE LABELS command replaces column’s earlier labels, SPSS (ADD VALUE LABELS adds instead). , first set kept. message lists columns whose earlier, different labels replaced. SPSS GET DATA files read right positions. column positions count 0, every column used read one position early. SPSS, GET DATA formats F7.1 don’t imply decimal places. Setup files aren’t valid UTF-8 read Windows-1252, curly quotes dashes labels read correctly (see ). asciiSetupReader now needs R 4.1.0 later (dependencies vroom, readr stringr already ).

title: asciiSetupReader 2.6.0
text: coerce_numeric = TRUE now checks every row converting column numeric. Previously files 50,000 rows random sample rows checked (file exactly 50,000 rows 5,000), column rare text values converted numeric, silently turning values NA, differently every run. sampling also changed user’s random number stream. Values bytes invalid current locale longer cause error checking numeric columns (column stays character) applying open-ended missing value ranges. make_sps_setup() works R >= 4.5.0 (failed “NA coercion boolean”), works col_labels isn’t given, longer leaves sink() open fails. file_name ending “.SPS” longer gets second extension, one merely ending “sps” (e.g. “datasps”) longer cut short. Missing values given “X thru highest” longer fail “labels must unique” value X appears data. Open-ended missing value ranges now match zero-padded data (e.g. “0000012” “0000009 THRU HI”). Previously values left data. Missing value ranges written “LO THRU X” “LOWEST THRU X” now applied. Previously “low thru” recognized, ignored. make_sps_setup()’s missing_values accepts column names well labels. Previously column name treated missing value column . SPSS setup files whose first line DATA LIST can now read.

title: asciiSetupReader 2.6.0
text: Parsing setup files much faster, especially files many columns (e.g. PSID setup files: 2 minutes 10 seconds). Reading data faster: data longer copied twice, value labels missing values applied direct lookup.

title: asciiSetupReader 2.6.0

Data files read vroom . vroom failed, package used retry silently readr, since readr 2.0 reads vroom , retry rarely helped hid vroom’s error. Now vroom’s error shown. package longer depends haven zoo. Requires R >= 3.6.0 (vroom already ). Examples now run, code commented. Adds GitHub Actions R CMD check workflow, replacing Travis AppVeyor.
